title: test(vi-mock-inherit): pin COVERED_SPECIFIERS membership in both directions
body:
Fixes #8018

## The defect, restated from the code

`scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`'s header declares the covered set **GROW-ONLY**
(`* The workspace packages this gate judges. GROW-ONLY, and a specifier joins it / * only after its frozen factories have been swept to zero`),
and the ratchet's whole force rests on that. But `findCallSites` classifies by **membership**:

```js
: isCovered(specifier)
  ? 'covered'
  : specifier.startsWith('@object-ui/')
    ? 'workspace'
    : 'external';

if (scope !== 'covered') {
  sites.push({ fn: m[1], specifier, scope, verdict: 'unjudged', viaImport, line });
  continue;
}
```

A specifier that **leaves** the set stops being `covered`, so its whole population turns
`unjudged`. A removal therefore reddens nothing — it makes that population invisible while
the gate reports OK over a tree it no longer looks at. `FLOORS.covered = 50` does not reach:
the set holds 666 judged sites today, so dropping even the largest member leaves the floor
satisfied.

## What was measured, and where the card's exhibit does not hold

Measured on `86ef0c764` by dropping **each of the 21 members** from the gate's constant in
turn and running the guard's own suite (86 cases before this PR). Three outcomes, not one:

| outcome | members | judged sites |
| --- | --- | --- |
| suite fully **GREEN** on removal — unprotected | **18** | **384** |
| reddens by its own deliberate pin (`toContain(I18N)`) | `@object-ui/i18n` | 93 |
| reddens **incidentally** | `@object-ui/react` (11 cases), `@object-ui/components` (1 case) | 139 + 50 |

⚠️ So the card's headline exhibit is falsified in one half. `@object-ui/react` has no
membership assertion — that part is right — but dropping it today does **not** leave the
guard's suite green: 11 cases fail, because the file's fixture constant
`const COVERED = '@object-ui/react'` is that same member and those cases run against the
default covered set, and because `THE ELEVEN, pinned against the real files` reads real
files that mock it. `@object-ui/components` reddens the same accidental way, through
`THE SUBPATH SITES` (`@object-ui/components/ui/sonner`).

That is protection by coincidence: it depends on a fixture spelling and on which files
happen to exist on disk, it names no ratchet in its failure text, and it covers exactly two
members. The defect the card filed is real and **larger** than the card measured — the
unprotected population is 18 members and 384 judged call sites, `@object-ui/auth` (136) and
`@object-ui/permissions` (48) among them, not one member and 134 sites.

## The shape, and why this one

A hand-written **ledger literal** in the test file, pinned in **both** directions.

- **Not derived from `COVERED_SPECIFIERS`.** A pin that reads its expectation from the thing
  it pins asserts `x === x`. The cautionary example was already in this file: the verdict-line
  case builds `const named = COVERED_SPECIFIERS.join(', ')`, so it *adapts* to a removal
  rather than resisting it.
- **`NOTHING LEAVES the covered set`** — every ledger entry must still be a member. This is
  the ratchet direction, and it is the existing `toContain(I18N)` rationale applied to all 21.
- **`NOTHING JOINS unrecorded`** — every member must be in the ledger. This is the answer to
  "a hand-copy will drift": without it the ledger is a snapshot that decays, and every
  specifier added after today inherits exactly the unprotected state the 18 were measured in.
  With it, the sweep PR that widens the constant widens the ledger too — the same PR the
  gate's own "precondition for widening" already requires. A member added tomorrow arrives
  **already pinned**.
- **Nothing was weakened.** `length > 0`, the real-package loop and `toContain(I18N)` are
  untouched; no threshold moved, no assertion was deleted, nothing is skipped. The gate file
  itself is unchanged — this is a test-only change.

### What it still permits, stated so nobody reads it as more

An author who deletes a member from the constant **and** its ledger line in one edit passes.
That is the floor of any literal pin, and it is the point: the promise is that a member cannot
leave *silently*, not that it can never leave. Retirement becomes a visible, reviewable edit
to a list whose docblock says the set only grows. Two further limits: the ledger carries names
only (the gate's header already holds the slice, measurement and PR behind each entry, and a
second copy of that provenance here would be the unchecked hand-copy this case exists to
catch), and it says nothing about whether a member's sites are *swept* — that remains the
gate's own job.

## The mutation test

Legs mutate the **gate's** constant, never the test. Each leg proves the edit reached disk by
an anchored `grep -c` and a blob hash before/after, restores with
`git checkout HEAD -- scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` from an `EXIT INT TERM` trap, and
proves restoration by comparing `git hash-object` against `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` — never
by an exit code. An empty hash or an unchanged count aborts the leg as a void reading.

**Post-change, all 21 removal legs (the deliverable):** every one goes red, and for the 18
previously-unprotected members **exactly** the new pin fails —
`Tests 1 failed | 87 passed (88)`, the single failure being
`NOTHING LEAVES the covered set — every swept specifier is still a member`. `@object-ui/i18n`
fails 2 (new pin + its own), `@object-ui/react` fails 12 (new pin + the 11 incidental ones).
The rest of the suite keeps passing in every leg.

**Control leg (the defect reproduced):** the same removals against the **unmodified** test
file — 18 of 21 leave `Tests 86 passed (86)`, exit 0. Without that reading the pin would close
nothing; with it, the 18 green legs are exactly what turned red above.

**The other direction can fail too:** adding `@object-ui/layout` to the gate's constant without
recording it in the ledger gives `Tests 1 failed | 87 passed (88)`, the failure being
`NOTHING JOINS unrecorded — a new member is pinned in the PR that adds it`.
Anchored count `0 -> 1`, blob `08a986a0 -> 6527a9c1`, restored to `08a986a0` by hash.

## Checks

Run on `7c8d521e2`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` — `Tests 88 passed (88)` (86 before).
- `node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` — exit 0, `check-vi-mock-inherit: OK`, 666 judged / 0 frozen / 0 other workspace.
- `pnpm run type-check:scripts` (`tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`, the program that types this file) — exit 0.
- `eslint` over the whole `lint:root` population, not a narrowed subset — 286 files, 0 errors, 32 pre-existing warnings, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — exit 0; the changeset declares empty frontmatter (test-only, nothing released).

Package `lint` / `type-check` / `test` were not run: no package source is touched — the diff is
one test file under `scripts/__tests__/` plus the changeset. CI runs the farm.
